method: Re-checked against the official PDF (pages 10-14 and the marking scheme on pages 17-20) with pdftotext -layout, -raw and -table, and the chapter summaries.

checks.reason: Chapter analytical-chemistry is not supported: thermal decomposition of zinc nitrate is not identification of cations with NaOH/NH4OH or amphoteric behaviour, the only content of that chapter's official summary.
Text alters the printed instruction: page 11 prints 'Name the main metal present in the following alloys: (a) Duralumin' but the item reads 'the following alloy: Duralumin.'.
Text alters the printed instruction: page 11 prints 'Name the main metal present in the following alloys: (b) Brass' but the item reads 'the following alloy: Brass.'.

Text rewrites the printed instruction ('write balanced chemical equation for the preparation of the salts mentioned below: (a) copper sulphate' becomes 'write a balanced chemical equation for the preparation of the salt: copper sulphate'), and a salt-preparation item belongs to acids-bases-and-salts (preparation of salts), not the sulphuric-acid chapter.

Text rewrites the printed instruction ('...preparation of the salts mentioned below: (b) sodium zincate' becomes '...preparation of the salt: sodium zincate'), and Zn + NaOH to sodium zincate is not supported by the metallurgy summary (ores, aluminium extraction, alloys).

Text rewrites the printed instruction 'Identify the reactants P, Q and R in the following reactions:' as 'Identify the reactant P in the following reaction:', and reduction of copper oxide by hydrogen is not in the metallurgy summary (ores, concentration, aluminium extraction, alloys).
Text rewrites the printed instruction 'Identify the reactants P, Q and R in the following reactions:' as 'Identify the reactant Q in the following reaction:'.

Text rewrites the printed instruction 'Identify the reactants P, Q and R in the following reactions:' as 'Identify the reactant R in the following reaction:', and the NaCl + AgNO3 precipitation is not the NaOH/NH4OH cation identification that the analytical-chemistry summary covers.
Official answer is not verbatim: the scheme prints 'because it is not made fully of silver only its top coating is of silver' with no comma; the stored answer inserts one ('silver, only').

Chapter metallurgy is not supported: distinguishing zinc and aluminium by the action of concentrated NaOH is the amphoteric-metal/alkali test of analytical-chemistry, not ores, aluminium extraction or alloys.
